source.rationale: BARRIER (b) OF THE M1/M2 UNREACHABILITY PROOF, asserted independently of barrier (a). Suppose a future edit put `members: true` back on a LANE row without deploying get-cs-members-miss: the plain arm's `real.every(p => p.members === false)` no longer holds and control reaches the roster parse. It still cannot produce a picker, because $input on this wiring is miss-roster-plan's OWN items — rosterAt() finds neither a `body` array nor a bare array, yields zero members, and the `!members.length` guard returns the untouched envelope. Expected is therefore the byte-identical central-exchange envelope: no miss_member_offer (M1's last_result_set concatenation stays dead) and no miss_offer_text (M2's 'reply with the company name' close is never composed).
